bio.text: Robin Richards, of the Nebraska Working People Party, is on the November 3, 2026 ballot as a candidate for the U.S. Senate in Nebraska.
She has been an at-large member of the Ralston Public Schools school board since November 25, 2019.
Ballotpedia says she was born in David City, Nebraska, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska Omaha in 2015, and has worked as a business manager for the Nebraska Arts Council.
